name: MultiCode
hints: The flag has been wrapped in several layers of common encodings such as ROT13, URL encoding, Hex, and Base64. Can you figure out the order to peel them back?
A tool like CyberChef can be interesting.
description: We intercepted a suspiciously encoded message, but it’s clearly hiding a flag. No encryption, just multiple layers of obfuscation. Can you peel back the layers and reveal the truth? Download the message.
